description: Deny-by-default ACL (security-plan §Tauri GUI): the frameless main window may drag, minimize, and close. App-defined commands (list_scenarios/start_run/stop_run, ch3) are registered via invoke_handler and need no core/plugin permission, so this allowlist stays exactly the three window capabilities; later run-report/operator-pause/live-counter Channel surfaces add only the core/plugin permissions they require.
